ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count number(5);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_DATE1 DATE;
 V_DATE2 DATE; 
 X NUMBER;
 
begin
SELECT COUNT(DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR)INTO V_COUNT
FROM
BRKR_MSTR L_BKM,
DCLTN_STATUS L_DCLTN_ST,
DCLTN_TYPES L_DCLTNT,
DECLARATIONS DCLTN,
VSSL_BLS VB
WHERE
VB.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD(+) AND
VB.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN(+) AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = L_DCLTNT.TYPE_ID(+) AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD(+) AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD = L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD(+) AND
DCLTN.BRKR_PORT_CD = L_BKM.PORT_CD(+) AND
DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = L_BKM.LIC_TYPE(+) AND
DCLTN.LIC_NBR = L_BKM.LIC_NBR(+) 

AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=2

AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(3,4,5,6)

AND
(DCLTN.PORT_CD=:P_PORT_CD OR :P_PORT_CD IS NULL)

AND
(DCLTN.GROUP_ID=:GROUP_ID OR :GROUP_ID IS NULL)

AND
(DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD=:DCLTN_TYPE OR :DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL)

AND
(DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR=:DCLTN_NBR OR :DCLTN_NBR IS NULL)

AND
(TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI')=TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') OR (:DCLTN_DT IS NULL))

AND
((TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') >=TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') OR (:START_DT IS NULL))

AND
(TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') <=TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') OR (:END_DT IS NULL)));
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
X :=FUN;
 IF X >=1 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CURR_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_GROUP_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:GROUP_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_C1', TEXT_PARAMETER,:CH1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_C2', TEXT_PARAMETER,:CH2);

 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FUN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FUN RETURN NUMBER IS

CURSOR C1 IS 
 SELECT VB.PORT_CD PORT_CD,VB.MFST_TYPE MFST_TYPE,VB.MFST_NBR MFST_NBR,VB.MFST_DT MFST_DT,VB.BL_SEQ BL_SEQ
 FROM BRKR_MSTR L_BKM,DCLTN_STATUS L_DCLTN_ST,DCLTN_TYPES L_DCLTNT,DECLARATIONS DCLTN,VSSL_BLS VB
 WHERE
 VB.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD(+) AND
 VB.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN(+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = L_DCLTNT.TYPE_ID(+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD(+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD = L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD(+) AND
 DCLTN.BRKR_PORT_CD = L_BKM.PORT_CD(+) AND
 DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = L_BKM.LIC_TYPE(+) AND
 DCLTN.LIC_NBR = L_BKM.LIC_NBR(+) 
 AND
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD=:DCLTN_TYPE OR :DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL)
 AND
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR=:DCLTN_NBR OR :DCLTN_NBR IS NULL)
 AND
 (DCLTN.GROUP_ID=:GROUP_ID OR :GROUP_ID IS NULL)
 AND
 (TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI')=TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') OR (:DCLTN_DT IS NULL))
 AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=2
 AND
 ((TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') >=TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') OR (:START_DT IS NULL))
 AND
 (TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') <=TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') OR (:END_DT IS NULL)));
------------------ 
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_MFST_NBR NUMBER;
 V_MFST_DT DATE;
 V_BL_SEQ NUMBER;
------------------
 V_IN_QTY NUMBER;
 V_BL_QTY NUMBER;
 V_REMIND NUMBER;
------------------
STAT_REP NUMBER;

X NUMBER DEFAULT 0;
BEGIN
 OPEN C1;
 LOOP
 FETCH C1 INTO V_PORT_CD,V_MFST_TYPE,V_MFST_NBR,V_MFST_DT,V_BL_SEQ;
 
 SELECT NVL(SUM(ENTRD_QTY),0)
 INTO V_IN_QTY
 FROM BL_ITEM_ENTRIES
 WHERE PORT_CD = PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = V_BL_SEQ;

-----------
 SELECT NVL(SUM(ACTL_QTY),0)
 INTO V_BL_QTY
 FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = V_BL_SEQ;

 V_REMIND:=V_BL_QTY-V_IN_QTY;
IF :CH1 =1 THEN
 IF :CH2 =1 THEN
 IF V_REMIND >0 THEN
 X:=X+1 ;
 RETURN X;
 ELSE
 X:=0;
 END IF;
 
 ELSIF :CH2 =0 THEN
 IF V_REMIND >0 THEN
 X:=X+1 ;
 RETURN X;
 ELSE
 X:=0;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF V_REMIND >0 THEN
 X:=X+1 ;
 RETURN X;
 END IF;
 
END IF;
EXIT WHEN C1%NOTFOUND; 
END LOOP;
CLOSE C1;
RETURN X;
END;
